1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
8: 
9:   // Ship
10:   const ship = {x: width/2, y: height - 30, w: 20, h: 30, fuel: 100};
11:   // Input handling
12:   let mouseX = ship.x;
13:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
14:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
15:     mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
16:   });
17:   const keys = {};
18:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
19:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
20: 
21:   // Asteroids & fuel pickups
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   const fuels = [];
24:   let frame = 0;
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let gameOver = false;
27: 
28:   function spawnAsteroid() {
29:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
30:     asteroids.push({x: Math.random()*(width-size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 + Math.random()*2});
31:   }
32:   function spawnFuel() {
33:     const size = 12;
34:     fuels.push({x: Math.random()*(width-size), y: -size, size, speed: 2});
35:   }
36: 
37:   function update(dt) {
38:     // ship movement
39:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= 200*dt;
40:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += 200*dt;
41:     ship.x += (mouseX - ship.x) * 0.1; // smooth follow
42:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
43:     // fuel consumption
44:     ship.fuel -= dt * 5; // per second
45:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
46: 
47:     // spawn asteroids/fuel
48:     if (frame % 60 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
49:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnFuel();
50: 
51:     // update asteroids
52:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
53:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);
54:     // remove off‑screen
55:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y > height) asteroids.shift();
56:     while (fuels.length && fuels[0].y > height) fuels.shift();
57: 
58:     // collision
59:     for (const a of asteroids) {
60:       if (a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.size > ship.x && a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.size > ship.y) {
61:         gameOver = true; break;
62:       }
63:     }
64:     for (let i = fuels.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
65:       const f = fuels[i];
66:       if (f.x < ship.x + ship.w && f.x + f.size > ship.x && f.y < ship.y + ship.h && f.y + f.size > ship.y) {
67:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
68:         fuels.splice(i,1);
69:       }
70:     }
71:     score += dt * 10;
72:   }
73: 
74:   function draw() {
75:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
76:     // ship
77:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
78:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
79:     // asteroids
80:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
81:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.size, a.size));
82:     // fuel pickups
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
84:     fuels.forEach(f => ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.size, f.size));
85:     // UI
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
87:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
88:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.ceil(ship.fuel), 10, 20);
89:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 40);
90:     if (gameOver) {
91:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
92:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
93:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
94:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
95:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
96:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
97:     }
98:   }
99: 
100:   let last = performance.now();
101:   function loop(now) {
102:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
103:     last = now;
104:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
105:     draw();
106:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
107:   }
108:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
109: })();
